concepts.name: Agile is an approach, not a methodology
concepts.source: transcript - topic introduction through the agilemanifesto.org link
concepts.note: Untested. The definitional trap: agile is a characteristic applied to a process, and values guide the generation of principles.

concepts.name: The four Agile values
concepts.note: Untested. Assignment 2 paragraph 1. Watch for reading 'over' as 'instead of'.

concepts.name: The twelve principles
concepts.note: Untested. Assignment 2 requires referring to 1-2 SPECIFIC principles. The 'principles are not a contract' caveat is the load-bearing bit.

concepts.name: Working software as the measure of progress; continuous integration
concepts.source: transcript - working-software principle and CI discussion
concepts.note: Untested. Also directly affects project marks: commits are the evidence of contribution, and code quality is separately marked.

concepts.name: Customer collaboration when the Product Owner is unavailable
concepts.note: Untested. 'Be ahead of the game' - settle availability and the proceed-without-you rule in meeting one, anchored on a draft backlog. Supersedes L2-C08.

concepts.name: Responding to change vs scope creep
concepts.note: Untested. Two brakes: the up-front agreement, and the PO's ownership incentive. Technology switches are the legitimate pushback.

concepts.name: User stories - who, what, why
concepts.source: transcript - user-stories section; Canvas user-story page
concepts.note: Untested. Used weekly on the project. The 'who' slot exists because different user types get different UI and functionality.

concepts.name: Acceptance criteria become tests; TDD and the Code Runner trap
concepts.note: Untested. Specificity is the mechanism. Criteria are a floor, not a ceiling; coverage depth is a PO decision.

concepts.name: Scrum as a lightweight framework built around people; roles and self-organisation
concepts.source: transcript - Scrum introduction; reinforced by Canvas quiz Q7-Q10, Q19
concepts.note: Untested. Assignment 2 paragraph 2. 'Everyone is a leader and there is no leader'. Merges with L1-C03 and supersedes L2-C08.

concepts.name: Transparency, inspection, adaptation
concepts.note: Untested. The opaque-sub-team failure is the default outcome on an 8-person team unless tooling prevents it.

concepts.name: Corrective, adaptive and perfective maintenance
concepts.source: transcript - adaptation pillar into maintenance taxonomy
concepts.note: Untested. Perfective is the hazard - no trigger. Do not conflate 'adaptation' (a pillar) with 'adaptive maintenance' (a code-change category).

concepts.name: Scrum events, artefacts and the cycle
concepts.source: transcript - events/artefacts walkthrough and Canvas quiz Q11-Q20
concepts.note: Untested. Review inspects the product, retrospective inspects the team. The PO is excluded from the daily scrum. Increment (not the velocity chart) is the transparent view of product state.

concepts.name: Teamwork risks and mitigations
concepts.source: transcript - teamwork-risks section after the retrospective discussion
concepts.note: Untested. Pair every member with a backup; escalate early because week ten is too late. Overlaps L4-C10 (retrospective) heavily.
